source_fact: construct_class currently calls cls->alloc_fn(ctx), virtual init_fields(ctx), then virtual _init with original args. All674 generated allocators know the exact generated C++ type.
candidate: An internal exact-metadata factory combines the original default construction, existing conditional method-row seed and the same most-derived init_fields call in one typed function. construct_class then invokes the original _init expression with original arguments.
potential_value: Gives the compiler one known typed allocation/initialization body; it may remove redundant default-value stores or virtual setup dispatch while retaining any stores needed by callbacks. Value remains unmeasured; refresh deployed-binary stacks and inspect actual generated stores before selecting it.
